candidate.definition_en: Relating to a large company or group.
candidate.explanation_ar: أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالشركات الكبيرة والمؤسسات الضخمة.

senses.definition_en: Relating to a large business company or group.
senses.explanation_ar: متعلق بشركة تجارية كبيرة أو مؤسسة.
examples: He works in a corporate office.
We attended a corporate event last night.
She wants to climb the corporate ladder.
